capabilities: Visualize the vault as a 3D solar system where note appearance reflects link or folder hierarchy
Open notes by clicking orbiting bodies, with camera follow and new-tab options
Switch the hierarchy basis between wikilinks and folder structure
Tune star thresholds, orbital motion, lighting, shadows and performance settings
Rebuild the system around any note with Alt-click
extras: Desktop only because it needs a GPU; the listing notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Includes a troubleshooting section for darkness, missing body classes, and slowness on large vaults.
problem: Obsidian's graph view is flat and abstract, so hierarchy and how notes cluster around hub notes is hard to see at a glance.
summary: 3D graph view that renders the vault as a solar system, with notes as planets orbiting the notes they belong to.
